author: Sheldon Krause
title: State board again rejects recall petition against Antrim County clerk - NewsBreak
text:
By Sheldon Krause ,
2 hours ago
ANTRIM COUNTY — The State Board of Canvassers again rejected a recall petition against Antrim County Clerk Victoria Bishop.
Bishop has been under investigation by Michigan election officials. She’s accused of altering voter registrations outside of the position’s authority.
Bishop had her access to the state’s Qualified Voter File suspended in June by the State Bureau of Elections.
The reason for the recall reads that, “Between July 24, 2025, and June 3, 2026, Antrim County Clerk Victoria Bishop made changes to voter records outside her statutory authority.”
A Republican member of the state board of canvassers took issue with this language, saying it was not specific enough.
The petition received two votes in support and one against, with one Republican member being absent.
But any petition also needs approval from at least one member of each party, meaning the effort failed for a second time.
